svg.title: Candidate pool searched: Laya alone reads up to 150 measured options and cannot run at 10,000; Laya with your own index and MahaBodi both search 5.9 million pages and decide among 20
svg.text: all options in one pass; measured on CLINC150
bring your own embeddings, index and glue
memory + retrieval built in (PostgreSQL at 5.9M, loaded with scripts)
Height = candidate pool searched, not accuracy; both towers decide among 20 retrieved candidates. At 100K MahaBodi beats Laya + dense (0.177 vs 0.121);

at 5.9M the v1 store ties it (0.103 vs 0.122, 8.3 s); at a 1M constructed pool the v2 store beats it (0.164 vs 0.129, 6.2 s p50); a remembered alias prior beats both (0.75–0.80). Details: BENCHMARKS.md.
